title: EchoSpec: Training Search Agents to Weigh Evidence Above Echoes
abstract: arXiv:2611.20034v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Search agents trained with reinforcement learning decide what to retrieve, when to search again, and when to answer. In real corpora, one claim is copied and paraphrased across many pages while the primary source settling a question appears once. We show that reinforcement-learned search agents grant echoes the credence of independent sources and lose their ability to abstain. Across five base models from 3B to 32B and seven released RL agents on multi-hop Wikipedia questions with primary evidence intact, eight paraphrased false-claim echoes overturn 58-73% of previously correct answers, while exact-match RL drives deleted-evidence abstention below 15%. Conditioning on retrieval localizes the failure to evidence acquisition: once primary evidence enters context, agents overrule eight echoes as reliably as one, whereas echoes fill top ranks and halt search early, so larger budgets, forced search turns, or passive passage filtering alone f

translated_title: EchoSpec：训练搜索智能体在“回声”之上权衡证据
translated_abstract: 经过强化学习训练的搜索智能体能够决定检索什么内容、何时再次搜索以及何时作答。在真实语料库中，同一论断常被复制并改写后散布于众多页面，而能够解答问题的关键一手来源却往往只出现一次。我们证明，经强化学习训练的搜索智能体会将这些“回声”当作独立来源加以采信，并丧失弃权（拒答）的能力。在五个参数量从3B到32B的基础模型和七个已发布的强化学习智能体上，针对一手证据完好保留的多跳维基百科问题，八条经过改写的虚假论断回声能够推翻58%至73%原本正确的答案，而基于精确匹配的强化学习使智能体在证据被删除时的弃权率降至15%以下。基于检索过程的条件分析将这一失败定位于证据获取阶段：一旦一手证据进入上下文，智能体推翻八条回声与推翻一条同样可靠；而回声则会占据检索排名的前列并使搜索过早终止，因此单纯依靠更大的检索预算、强制搜索轮次或被动的段落过滤无法解决该问题。
tldr: 该论文发现强化学习训练的搜索智能体会把被大量转载改写的虚假“回声”论断误当作独立证据、丧失弃权能力，并定位出失败根源在于证据获取阶段，主张训练智能体优先采信一手证据而非回声。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that RL-trained search agents mistake paraphrased false-claim echoes for independent evidence and lose their ability to abstain, localizing the failure to evidence acquisition and arguing agents must be trained to weigh primary evidence above echoes.
